notes.title: Snow Ash Demo Available NOW!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324911/822ab73543817913ac7691a1bd9cd7f812d46a41.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Dear Messenger,[/b][/p][p]This is Ember Studio. We’re thrilled to announce that the [i]Snow Ash[/i] Demo is now officially released on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]The snow have ravaged the world, leaving only a few shelters standing. Food is scarce, fuel is running low. As a messenger braving the frozen winds to deliver goods, perhaps you can bring warmth and hope to those still holding on in the snow.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367030/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]A Unique Card-Based System[/b][/p][p]Your deck is generally divided into two types of cards: combat cards for fighting, and mobility cards for advancing. Card effects scale with character stats, and some cards consume valuable resources. Careful resource management and deck-building before setting out are key to ensuring a smooth and efficient delivery journey.[/p][p][/p][p][b]A Deep Trading Experience[/b][/p][p]With over 20 shelters and dozens of trading posts, each location offers different goods for trade. Buy low at production sites, barter valuable items like food, medicine, and fuel with vagrants, then sell high where demand peaks to earn your fortune. Besides trading, goods are also crucial for maintaining your team—stock up at production sites so you can spend freely when the time comes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Story-Driven Adventure[/b][/p][p]The Demo currently features 6 unlockable team members, each with their own quests and storylines. Talk with them during your journey to uncover the stories behind their identities. Help fulfill their wishes, and they’ll stand by your side through hardships—supporting each other as true companions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for trying out [i]Snow Ash[/i]. If you enjoy the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist to stay updated on future developments![/p][p]If you have any bugs to report, feedback, or suggestions, feel free to join our official Discord channel for discussion![/p][p][/p][p][b]Ember Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: Indie game "雪原余烬 Snow Ash" First test started
notes.content:
[b]Test description[/b]
The test application channel will be open at 18:00 on 2025/02/21 Beijing time (UTC+8).
You can apply directly on the store page of Snow Ash at that time.
The application channel will be open for one week, and there is no limit on the number of applications for this test (that is, all applications before 18:00 on 2025/02/28 will be approved).
The qualification will be issued within 1-3 working days after the application.

[b]Special description[/b]
The game version tested this time still has the following problems:
1. The UI is not fully completed
2. AI is used, and the problematic characters and some scenes have not been replaced
3. The content of the plot and gameplay is still relatively small
We will gradually produce and optimize in the subsequent development. I hope everyone can treat the test version in development rationally. Thank you~

[b]Finally added[/b]
I hope everyone can fill in the in-game questionnaire after experiencing the game to help us better improve the game~
You are also welcome to join the discord to participate in the discussion!
I hope every player can enjoy the game!
